# WordConvertHTML

## About
WordConvertHTML is a free, browser-based tool that converts Microsoft Word documents and rich text content into clean, semantic HTML code. It runs entirely client-side — no data is ever sent to a server.

## Features
- Word to HTML conversion with real-time preview
- Automatic cleaning of Word-specific markup and inline styles
- Semantic HTML output (strong/em instead of b/i)
- Export as HTML file, copy to clipboard, or print
- 9 individual cleaning tools (remove styles, classes, IDs, comments, etc.)
- Dark mode support
- Fully responsive design

## How It Works
1. Paste Word content into the editor or upload a .docx file
2. The editor auto-converts and cleans the HTML
3. Use cleaning tools to further refine the output
4. Export clean HTML via copy, download, or print

## Privacy
All processing happens in the browser. No data leaves the user's device. No cookies, no analytics, no tracking.
